card.name: Partway through cancer-risk words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a split cancer word, such as the 'align' in malignant, 'oste' in osteosarcoma, 'lymph' in lymphomas or 'malign' in malignancies. It appears in warnings about tumor risk.

modes.label: Split malignancy words
modes.description: Early piece of malignant or malignancies after M or 'development of'.

modes.label: Split tumor-type words
modes.description: Start of osteosarcoma or lymphoma after 'incidence of' or 'rate of'.
modes.example: Higher rate of<< lymph>>omas and lung cancers with tofacitin
